determinism.note: a single cold capture; cross-run determinism is NOT asserted here. Capture a second cold run and run `fidelity-dataset compare --self-compare` -- an exactly 0.0 result is the SC-1 reproduction confirmation.

First: model.layers.0.self_attn.kv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight [640, 6144]->[576, 6144], model.layers.1.self_attn.kv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight [640, 6144]->[576, 6144], model.layers.2.self_attn.kv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight [640, 6144]->[576, 6144].

this dataset is ONE cold capture (run_count 1, the DET-D4 floor is 5). Cross-run determinism is not asserted by the dataset; it is established by a second cold capture plus `fidelity-dataset compare --self-compare`, whose exactly-0.0 result is the SC-1 reproduction confirmation.

generation_sanity_probe.note: one extra window through the same schedule; its hidden state is discarded and never enters the dataset.

divergences.reason: every capture declares its OWN head identity by tensor content digest; the comparator refuses a hidden-form comparison across differing heads.
lane is required and gated at compare time so registry BIAS-006 is checked before a number exists, not at submission.
scoring_window is part of panel identity, not a comparator flag: a score_from=1024 number is a different panel, not a variant.
self-compare is a first-class mode asserting exactly 0.0.
required, fp64 default; an fp32 estimator lands in a different comparability class on the same data and that must be visible.
declared vs present record counts with shard_of; fixes our own manifest that claimed 5,120 captures in a 512-file repository.
the panel is a separately referenceable object, which is what makes a candidate capture publishable standalone.
lets a llama.cpp .kld be ingested without laundering a lossy capture as exact.
our packed and streaming lanes vary mask construction; a single-request capture path makes it invariant and has no equivalent field.
hidden form is the default; logit form must declare head_separable:false with a reason.

scoring_window.policy: every causal prediction position of every window is scored; nothing is dropped
